_kiosk_pin_note: `kiosk_pin` seeds the numeric PIN that unlocks the kiosk's staff strip. It is a
committed, publicly-readable default and is therefore treated like one: the seed
refuses to set it when ENV=production, and it is only ever written to a user who
has no PIN yet, so re-seeding never clobbers a PIN an operator has rotated.
Rotate or clear it with `make kiosk-pin` (backend/scripts/set_kiosk_pin.py).
_phone_note: Phone numbers here are unroutable by construction: Indian mobile numbers start
with 6-9, so a +91 5xxxxxxxxx number can never reach a real handset. That is
deliberate. Seeds get loaded on demo and staging boxes, and from S3 those boxes
may have a live SMS provider configured — a plausible-looking number would send
real OTP texts to a stranger. Real numbers are entered per-hospital via the admin
